camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeNatFirewallList --region cn-hangzhou --Status normal --RegionNo 'cn-hangzhou' --PageSize 10 --VpcId 'vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000' --MemberUid 147783000000 --ProxyId 'proxy-nat97a000000' --ProxyName 'nat-firewall' --Lang zh --PageNo 1 --NatGatewayId 'ngw-bp123456g000000'
description_zh: 本接口用于获取NAT边界防火墙的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-nat-firewall-list --lang zh --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --proxy-id proxy-nat97a000000 --proxy-name nat-firewall --region-no cn-hangzhou --vpc-id vpc-8vbwbo90rq0anm6t0000 --nat-gateway-id ngw-bp123456g000000 --status normal --member-uid 147783000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeNatFirewallList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The number of NAT firewalls to return on each page for a paged query.

The default value is **10**. The maximum value is **50**
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，设置每页包含NAT边界防火墙的数量。

默认值为**10**，表示每页包含**10**条结果。最大值为**50**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT firewall
parameters.name: proxy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the NAT firewall. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It cannot start with an underscore (\_)
parameters.help_zh: NAT防火墙名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为[4,50]个字符,且不能以下划线开头
parameters.name: proxy_name

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC.

> For more information about the regions where Cloud Firewall is available, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPC所在的地域ID。

> 关于云防火墙支持地域的详细信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195657.html
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT Gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the Cloud Firewall. Valid values:

- configuring: The firewall is being created.

- deleting: The firewall is being deleted.

- normal: The firewall is working as expected.

- abnormal: The firewall is not working as expected.

- opening: The firewall is being enabled.

- closing: The firewall is being disabled.

- closed: The firewall is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
云防火墙状态。取值：

- configuring：创建中
- deleting：删除中
- normal：正常
- abnormal：异常
- opening：开启中
- closing：关闭中
- closed：已关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid
